hints.title: Sort Internal Cuboid Dimensions
hints.text: To maximize vertical height, sort the three dimensions of each cuboid so the largest dimension serves as height.

hints.title: Sort Cuboids Lexicographically
hints.text: Sorting all cuboids guarantees that any cuboid stackable on another appears earlier in the sequence.

hints.title: Longest Increasing Subsequence DP
hints.text: Apply longest increasing subsequence dynamic programming: cuboid i can stack on cuboid j if all three dimensions of j are <= cuboid i.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all 6 rotations per cuboid and all topological stack orderings takes factorial time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting each cuboid internally plus O(n^2) DP optimizes height in polynomial time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate proves that making the largest dimension the height is globally optimal for all cuboids.
